newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Wah Lee says IPO 32.6 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Wah Lee says IPO 32.6 times subscribed.

text.p: Air-conditioning systems, audio visual and photographic products distributor Wah Lee Resources Holdings Ltd said its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong was 32.6 times subscribed.

The company said it received applications for a total of 2.05 billion shares compared with 63 million shares available for public subscription. Another seven million shares for employees were also fully allotted, it said.
Trading in the shares is expected to begin on January 17, the company said.
Wah Lee offered 70 million shares at HK$1.00 each in an IPO. A warrant will be attached to every five shares subscribed.
It said net proceeds would be used to promote products, set up product display showrooms across China, buy a warehouse in Hong Kong and for working capital.
